notes.title: Stay away from the bear
notes.notes:
[p]Unfortunately there was a break in the development related to my general health, so unluckily I will not be able to finish the project this year.[/p][p align="start"]The good news is that last few weeks I started pushing it forward really hard. And will probably go faster, because I ordered new - much stronger - PC (still, I will use the old one for testing purpose,  to make sure it will run smoothly on slightly older machines).[/p][p align="start"]As for the project itself, I've come with a few more ideas for puzzles and locations, so I'm pretty excited with creating the new stuff.[/p][p align="start"]There were also some changes in UI due to the feedback from people who were testing the game, especially with the big numbers of documents. From now on, there will be indications if document is strictly related to puzzle. When solved, it will be indicated with checkmark.

notes.title: The Work Continuous
notes.notes:
Like often happens in the game dev world, there has been a delay. Hopefully the last time.

I am not good at small talk, so I will do it in form of quick-self Q&A. Most of it, I've already shared on itch.io page. But I'll share also here, so everyone interested in the game can keep in sync with the news.



[b]What is taking so long?[/b]

Well... Many things. Doing everything by myself is going longer than expected. And random events in personal also are not helping, but I am not going to look for excuses for myself. Often things are more time consuming than I thought, and besides, I am having a lot of new ideas that I want to implement. I also do not want to rush the project. They were some tests of the game with my friends, and were some changes due to their feedback. They game is not aiming to be a big AAA title (more like a half of an A), but that does not mean I want to create something that is not fun at all.


[b]Can't you just use an AI, or ask someone for help?[/b]

I have my own vision of the game. I do not want to broken by anyone (or by some tool). Besides... I'm having fun while creating this game.


[b]So what now? When it is gonna be released?[/b]

Hard to tell. For now I've moved the date by one year [u][b](Q4 2025).[/b][/u] The game is completed in something like 70%, the number of rooms in the game have already exceeded 150.



The good news is that the work continuous, just is taking more than I planned.
